results.title: Asian Games 2026 Cricket: Vaibhav Sooryavanshi Sets Unique Record as India Beat Pakistan for Gold Medal
results.description: Vaibhav Sooryavanshi created history at Asian Games 2026 as India defeated Pakistan in the men's cricket final to win gold. The 15-year-old batting prodigy became the youngest Indian to win an Asian Games cricket gold medal, adding another milestone to his record-breaking year.
